name: Purepure
source:
On the moonless night the hero stumbles upon a strange girl. She speaks of herself as master of ceremonies that was kicked out due to being useless. She ends up living with the hero. What's there behind her past?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个无月之夜，主人公偶然遇见了一位奇怪的女孩。她自称是一名司仪，却因为毫无用处而被赶了出来。最后，她与主人公一起生活。她的过去究竟隐藏着什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
